tools.name: get_file
tools.title: Get recording details and audio download URL

annotations.title: Get recording details and audio download URL

description.text: Get the full record for a Plaud recording: metadata, the audio download URL, and an inventory of its transcript blocks and notes. This is the tool that returns audio — `presigned_url` is a signed link to the recording's audio file, valid 24h, and is how you download it or hand the user a download link. Call this whenever the user asks for the audio, the download link, or the recording file itself; use get_transcript or get_note to read transcript or note bodies instead.

file_id.description: The file ID to retrieve notes for

description.text: Fetch the notes on a Plaud recording — one entry per tab in the app, so usually more than one: the AI summary (action items, key topics), any template tab, a saved Ask Plaud answer, and the highlights note when the user pressed the highlight button while recording.

file_id.description: The file ID to retrieve transcript for

block.description: Which source block to fetch: `transaction` (default; raw transcript, speaker + timestamps), `transaction_polish` (AI-cleaned transcript; same per-utterance shape, keeps speaker + timestamps), `outline`, or `mark_memo` (highlights: the moments flagged by pressing the button on the device during recording; present only when the button was pressed, and returned under `marks`). Pair `mark_memo` with a `transaction` call to map each flagged moment onto what was said there.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call's `next_cursor`. Omit to start from the first utterance.

limit.description: Max items to return in this page (default 50). Only applies to list-shaped blocks.

description.text: Fetch the timestamped transcript with speaker attribution for a Plaud recording. Defaults to the `transaction` block (real speaker names + timestamps), returned one page of utterances at a time to stay within client size limits — call again with the returned `next_cursor` to fetch the next page. Set `block` to `outline`, `transaction_polish`, or `mark_memo` (the moments the user flagged with the device's highlight button) to fetch those blocks instead.

page_size.description: Items per page, minimum 10 (ignored when `query` is set)

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on recording name. No backend support — scans the newest 500 recordings, narrowed to date_from/date_to first when given.

date_from.description: Start date inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the server's timezone. Applied server-side, exact.

date_to.description: End date inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the server's timezone. Applied server-side, exact.

description.text: List Plaud recordings. `date_from`/`date_to` (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) filter server-side on the recording's display date — exact, no scan limit, safe over any range (including `page`/`page_size` paging through the filtered set). `query` (case-insensitive name substring) has no backend support: it scans the newest 500 recordings (5 pages of 100), narrowed to `date_from`/`date_to` first when given. Check `complete` before treating a `query` result as exhaustive — when false, `note` says what was not checked.
